test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 24 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the pair that follows the same pattern as that followed by the two set of pairs given below. Both pairs follow the same pattern.

HJI−GIH

EGF−DFE
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/06181392e9897efb4b81331befbf0235a23822489dcd574e6efffefb8787d3bd.png] 

Logic followed here is: Each letter in the second term of the pair is obtained by subtracting 1 from the positional value of the corresponding letter in the first term (Position - 1).

**For HJI − GIH →**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8b0e23b82098aba9dddd64b847cabb703cf7b50f7bd0758786534fa5abd24b0d.png] 

 

**For EGF − DFE →**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd7babcf96788ddb18d36fff6505db938c8d194bccf241cae658436d3e19598e.png] 

 

**Similarly, Option 1) GIH − FHG:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ebd3f284a20fd234106c804323478e8dcd5e9987314e9fe9776376135a1ce1f1.png] 

Therefore, the pair 'GIH−FHG' follows the same pattern.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
